scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Lower-Fat Coleslaw: mayonnaise, milk, white vinegar, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, white sugar, salt, cabbage, onion, carrot.

Step 1 of Lower-Fat Coleslaw: Whisk mayonnaise, low-fat milk, white vinegar, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, and salt together in a bowl and allow dressing to stand while preparing vegetables, about 20 minutes..
Step 2 of Lower-Fat Coleslaw: Pour dressing over cabbage, onion, and carrot in a large salad bowl and toss to combine. For best flavor, refrigerate slaw at least 2 hours to overnight..
